chunks: Al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام would apply depilatory paste in the bathhouse, and when he reached the place of the private parts, he would say to the one applying it, “Move away,” then he himself would apply it to that area.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.مَوْضِعَ الْعَوْرَةِ: the area of the private parts

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام observe modesty when using depilatory paste in the bathhouse?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام in the bathhouse when using depilatory paste. It shows modesty and careful observance regarding the private parts, as he had that area treated by himself rather than by another person.
